title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
summary: Return the sum of every contiguous subarray minimum.
statement: Return the sum of every contiguous subarray minimum. Implement `sum_subarray_minimums` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Count how many subarrays ending here choose each stack value as their minimum.
Merge dominated minima and maintain the sum for all subarrays ending at the current position.
